description: This MCP server integrates with your Google Drive and Google Sheets, to enable creating and modifying spreadsheets.

tool_signatures.name: add_chart
tool_signatures.description: Add a chart to a Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: add_columns
tool_signatures.description: Add columns to a sheet in a Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: add_rows
tool_signatures.description: Add rows to a sheet in a Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: batch_update
tool_signatures.description: Execute a batch update on a Google Spreadsheet using the full batchUpdate endpoint.

tool_signatures.name: batch_update_cells
tool_signatures.description: Batch update multiple ranges in a Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: copy_sheet
tool_signatures.description: Copy a sheet from one spreadsheet to another.

tool_signatures.name: create_sheet
tool_signatures.description: Create a new sheet tab in an existing Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: create_spreadsheet
tool_signatures.description: Create a new Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: find_in_spreadsheet
tool_signatures.description: Find cells containing a specific value in a Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: get_multiple_sheet_data
tool_signatures.description: Get data from multiple specific ranges in Google Spreadsheets.

tool_signatures.name: get_multiple_spreadsheet_summary
tool_signatures.description: Get a summary of multiple Google Spreadsheets, including sheet names,

tool_signatures.name: get_sheet_data
tool_signatures.description: Get data from a specific sheet in a Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: get_sheet_formulas
tool_signatures.description: Get formulas from a specific sheet in a Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: list_folders
tool_signatures.description: List all folders in the specified Google Drive folder.

tool_signatures.name: list_sheets
tool_signatures.description: List all sheets in a Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: list_spreadsheets
tool_signatures.description: List all spreadsheets in the specified Google Drive folder.

tool_signatures.name: rename_sheet
tool_signatures.description: Rename a sheet in a Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: search_spreadsheets
tool_signatures.description: Search for spreadsheets in Google Drive by name or content.

tool_signatures.name: share_spreadsheet
tool_signatures.description: Share a Google Spreadsheet with multiple users via email, assigning specific roles.

tool_signatures.name: update_cells
tool_signatures.description: Update cells in a Google Spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: folder_id (optional string)
tool_signatures.description: Google Drive folder ID to search in. Get from its URL. If omitted, uses the configured default folder or searches 'My Drive'.

tool_signatures.name: _Returns
tool_signatures.description: _ List of objects [{id: string, title: string}]

tool_signatures.name: title (string)
tool_signatures.description: The desired title for the spreadsheet. Example: "Quarterly Report Q4".

tool_signatures.name: spreadsheet_id (string)
tool_signatures.description: The spreadsheet ID (from its URL).

tool_signatures.name: sheet (string)
tool_signatures.description: Name of the sheet/tab (e.g., "Sheet1").

tool_signatures.name: range (optional string)
tool_signatures.description: A1 notation . If omitted, reads the whole sheet/tab specified by sheet.

tool_signatures.name: include_grid_data (optional boolean, default False)
tool_signatures.description: If True, returns full grid data including formatting and metadata (much larger). If False, returns values only (more efficient).

tool_signatures.name: range (string)
tool_signatures.description: A1 notation range to write to .

tool_signatures.name: data (array of arrays)
tool_signatures.description: 2D array of values to write. Example: [[1, 2, 3], ["a", "b", "c"]].

tool_signatures.name: ranges (object)
tool_signatures.description: Dictionary mapping range strings (A1 notation) to 2D arrays of values. Example: { "A1:B2": [[1, 2], [3, 4]], "D5": [["Hello"]] }.

tool_signatures.name: count (integer)
tool_signatures.description: Number of empty rows to insert.

tool_signatures.name: start_row (optional integer, default 0)
tool_signatures.description: 0-based row index to start inserting rows. If omitted, defaults to 0 (inserts at the beginning).

tool_signatures.name: queries (array of objects)
tool_signatures.description: Each object needs spreadsheet_id, sheet, and range. Example: [{"spreadsheet_id": "abc", "sheet": "Sheet1", "range": "A1:B2"}, ...].

tool_signatures.name: spreadsheet_ids (array of strings)
tool_signatures.description: IDs of the spreadsheets (from their URLs).

tool_signatures.name: rows_to_fetch (optional integer, default 5)
tool_signatures.description: How many rows (including header) to preview. Example: 5.

tool_signatures.name: recipients (array of objects)
tool_signatures.description: [{"email_address": "user@example.com", "role": "writer"}, ...]. Roles: reader, commenter, writer.

tool_signatures.name: send_notification (optional boolean, default True)
tool_signatures.description: Send email notifications to recipients.

tool_signatures.name: start_column (optional integer, default 0)
tool_signatures.description: 0-based column index to start inserting. If omitted, defaults to 0 (inserts at the beginning).

tool_signatures.name: src_spreadsheet (string)
tool_signatures.description: Source spreadsheet ID (from its URL).

tool_signatures.name: src_sheet (string)
tool_signatures.description: Source sheet/tab name (e.g., "Sheet1").

tool_signatures.name: dst_spreadsheet (string)
tool_signatures.description: Destination spreadsheet ID (from its URL).

tool_signatures.name: dst_sheet (string)
tool_signatures.description: Desired sheet/tab name in the destination spreadsheet.

tool_signatures.name: spreadsheet (string)
tool_signatures.description: The spreadsheet ID (from its URL).

tool_signatures.name: new_name (string)
tool_signatures.description: New sheet/tab name (e.g., "Transactions").

tool_signatures.name: chart_type (string)
tool_signatures.description: Type of chart to create. Options: COLUMN (vertical bars), BAR (horizontal bars), LINE, AREA, PIE, SCATTER, COMBO, HISTOGRAM.

tool_signatures.name: data_range (string)
tool_signatures.description: A1 notation range for the chart data . First row is treated as headers.

tool_signatures.name: title (optional string)
tool_signatures.description: Chart title.

tool_signatures.name: x_axis_label (optional string)
tool_signatures.description: Label for the X axis (bottom axis). Not applicable for pie charts.

tool_signatures.name: y_axis_label (optional string)
tool_signatures.description: Label for the Y axis (left axis). Not applicable for pie charts.

tool_signatures.name: position_x (optional integer, default 0)
tool_signatures.description: Horizontal position offset in pixels from the top-left corner.

tool_signatures.name: position_y (optional integer, default 0)
tool_signatures.description: Vertical position offset in pixels from the top-left corner.

tool_signatures.name: width (optional integer, default 600)
tool_signatures.description: Width of the chart in pixels.

tool_signatures.name: height (optional integer, default 400)
tool_signatures.description: Height of the chart in pixels.

tool_signatures.name: spreadsheet
tool_signatures.description: //{spreadsheet_id}/info: Get basic metadata about a Google Spreadsheet.

author: Xing Wu <xingwu.cs@gmail.com>
